newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Prods Outlook-Gasoline seen stuck in doldrums.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Prods Outlook-Gasoline seen stuck in doldrums.

text.p: U.S. spot gasoline prices are expected to remain in the doldrums this week due to poor demand and some bearish pressure from European imports, with early refinery turnarounds in the Gulf Coast offering limited support, traders said.

"Gasoline is a dog," one East Coast player said. "The upfront market is kind of ugly," he added, evidenced by NYMEX futures prices now veering into occasional slight contango -- with February material dipping in price below March values.
"Everybody is full on gasoline at the racks" in the Northeast, he added.
